description: Defines data transfer objects (DTOs) for 'Continue Watching' items, including serialization annotations and a response wrapper, used in API communication within the app.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingDto
classes.description: DTO representing a 'Continue Watching' item with fields for id, title, optional subtitle, optional artwork URL, and playback progress.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingResponse
classes.description: Wrapper class encapsulating a list of ContinueWatchingDto items as a response from the API.

methods.name: ContinueWatchingDto
methods.description: Primary constructor for the data class, initializes content item properties.

methods.name: ContinueWatchingResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing response with list of items.
